item.title: Sequential anion chemistry enables dynamic interphase regulation in high-voltage LiCoO 2
item.description:

Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a diluent-mediated sequential solvation strategy that selectively redistributes two anions around Li⁺, enabling sequential interfacial chemistry: DFOB⁻ builds the initial CEI, while BF₄⁻ dynamically repairs defects and quenches reactive oxygen. This stabilizes high-voltage LiCoO₂, achieving 500 cycles at 4.5 V (73.5% retention) and 265.8 Wh/kg pouch cells with excellent −20°C performance, providing mechanistic insight into solvation-driven anion chemistry.
🏷 LiCoO2 cathode · high-voltage · anion chemistry · CEI regulation · local solvation
